freeze.question: Can I freeze my membership?
freeze.answer: Yes, you can freeze your membership for up to 3 months per year for medical or travel reasons.

signupFees.question: Are there any signup fees?
signupFees.answer: No signup fees for our standard memberships. Elite memberships include a one-time initiation fee.

guests.question: Can I bring guests?
guests.answer: Premium and Elite members receive guest passes. Basic members can purchase day passes for guests.

cancellation.question: What's the cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: You can cancel anytime. Your membership remains active until the end of your billing period.
